observed_in: Religion and God System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls how piety is gained, maintained, and lost within a game, influencing player strategies and interactions with deities. Variations can include the types of actions that affect piety, the consequences of gaining or losing it, and the benefits provided by deities.
exclusion_criteria: Randomized piety changes without player input
Piety systems that do not affect gameplay
inclusion_criteria: Different methods of gaining piety (e.g., sacrifices, quests)
title: Piety Mechanics Variation
